stemMd: Which feature of pre-mill Orlen complicates the claim that earlier work was entirely task-based?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Assistants were paid according to agreed periods of work.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Home workshops produced no finished cloth.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Managers imposed identical fines across households.

options.label: E
options.textMd: All workers used identical factory bells.

explanationMd: Period-based payment is direct evidence that measured time mattered before the mills. It challenges the absolute contrast without denying that industrial institutions intensified time discipline.

distractorRationale.e: Factory bells belong to the later setting.
distractorRationale.c: That centralized enforcement is not stated for the earlier period.
distractorRationale.d: Deliveries were synchronized with those markets.
